output.answer_markdown: Gross margin as originally filed was 4.8% for FY2021 [1] and 5.3% for FY2022 [2]. Both gross profit figures were later restated, and the restated values are not given here. Boeing recognizes cost of sales under program accounting [4], and the 767, 777X and 787 programs had near break-even or single digit margins at December 31, 2022 [3], so gross margin is a program-driven and thin measure for this company. The material does not establish an improving trend on restated figures, so an improvement cannot be confirmed.
